game_concept: A action defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate, a weathered stone gate: the ruin warden must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Duplicate Sweep: Remove repeated items from a list of rune stones while keeping the order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate: a weathered stone gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Weathered Gate, repeat each round: Remove repeated items from a list of rune stones while keeping the order. Each round, eldritch shades strike the relic vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the clean_list value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the relic vault from eldritch shades in Weathered Gate: keep the clean_list meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 43-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: clean_list drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 43-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Duplicate Sweep
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
